verdict.rationale: Pendo documents an official MCP server that gives AI workflows access to usage data, visitor behavior, and customer context. It is listed in Claude's Connectors Directory, and Leo answers natural-language questions inside Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, so agent access to live product data is directly supported. However, nothing documents an agent running actual queries (funnels, retention, growth metrics) through the MCP tools or a public query API. The API evidence covers only event ingestion and deletion, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented MCP tool list or query capabilities for growth metrics, a public read/query API for analytics data, hands-on or independent corroboration of agents answering growth questions.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent answer growth questions from live product data by running queries through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Pendo with your AI workflows to get instant access to usage data, visitor behavior, and customer context, wherever you work.
Pendo is available in Claude's official Connectors Directory. Set up the integration directly from Claude, no manual configuration needed.
Product intelligence in Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more.
